title: Data Paper
description: A paper, or a deposit of the same data, that a trusted judgment classified as this dataset's own data paper: it introduces, describes, or releases the data in this specific dataset. Unlike the relation type on a related identifier, which is only a hint, membership here is a judged verdict.

doi.description: DOI of the data paper, without a resolver prefix (e.g., '10.1038/s41597-019-0027-4'). DOIs are case-insensitive; the producer serves them in canonical lowercase, so consumers must compare case-insensitively (for example against related_identifiers[].identifier).

title.description: Title of the paper as resolved from the DOI registry. Null when it could not be resolved.

venue.description: Journal, preprint server, or repository that published it (e.g., 'Scientific Data', 'bioRxiv'). Null when unknown.

judge_model.description: Identifier of the model that made the data-paper judgment (e.g., 'claude-sonnet-5-5'), as recorded by the pipeline in its judgment_model field. Null when not recorded.
